note: Course batches for Learn + Practice (step 5b) and questions (step 5c). Each course node is owned by exactly one batch: nodes already built in section 3.5 first, then the batches below in order, and any course node mapped to no section goes to the last batch. Each named item is taught by exactly one owner node (the first node that teaches it and is not already built). Items taught only by nodes already built in 3.5 are covered by a top-up batch that rebuilds those nodes with their original items plus the extra ones; its output replaces those nodes' 3.5 files.

top_up.extra_nodes_reason: The 3.5 blueprint recorded that the cash-flow forecast needs a visual layout and a construction task, but the first run did not enforce it; bus-fin-005 is rebuilt so the requirement is enforced.
